Gli LLM trasformano lingue, stili e codici passando attraverso una forma logica comune. La traduzione universale rende così trasparente il canale, riduce il valore delle mediazioni linguistiche e concentra ciò che conta agli estremi del processo: il punto di partenza e quello di arrivo

items.title: Attackers Exploit SharePoint Authentication Bypass After Public PoC Release
items.summary:
Threat actors have begun to exploit a newly disclosed Microsoft SharePoint vulnerability following the release of a proof-of-concept (PoC) code.

The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-55040 (CVSS score: 9.1), which refers to a critical security feature bypass that stems from weak authentication. It was patched by Microsoft as part of its July 2026 Patch Tuesday updates.
